Text: WHEN the TillPoint POS sends a purchase event for a member, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for that purchase.
Criterion: Given a registered member, when the TillPoint POS sends one purchase event for that member, then exactly one pending points transaction for that purchase and member exists.
Test idea: Send a sample purchase event in the S-02 JSON format to the event consumer; query the member's points transactions; expect one Pending transaction that references the purchase.

Text: The loyalty service shall award a member 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Criterion: For purchase amounts SGD 0.00, 0.99, 1.00, 1.99 and 150.75 the awarded points are 0, 0, 1, 1 and 150.
Test idea: Table-driven test of the points calculation with these amounts and no campaign active.

Text: WHILE a bonus campaign is active, the loyalty service shall multiply the points earned on each purchase the campaign covers by the campaign multiplier.
Criterion: While a bonus campaign with multiplier TBD covers a purchase, the points of that purchase are the R-002 points times the multiplier; a purchase the campaign does not cover earns the R-002 points.
Test idea: Unit test with a test campaign and multiplier; repeat for a purchase outside the campaign's coverage.
Question: Which purchases does a bonus campaign cover, and which multipliers exist? (owner: SH-07 Priya Raman)

Text: WHEN 24 hours have passed since a purchase that is not on fraud hold, the loyalty service shall post the pending points of that purchase.
Criterion: A pending points transaction for a purchase at time T without fraud hold is pending at T + 23 h 59 min and posted at T + 24 h; one on fraud hold is still pending at T + 24 h.
Test idea: With a controllable clock, create a purchase at T and check its status at T + 23 h 59 min and T + 24 h; repeat with a fraud hold placed at T + 1 h.

Text: IF a member returns a purchase whose points are still pending, THEN the loyalty service shall reverse the pending points of that purchase.
Criterion: When a member returns a purchase whose points are pending, the pending points transaction is reversed and the points are never posted.
Test idea: Create a purchase, return it at T + 1 h, advance the clock past T + 24 h; expect a Reversed transaction and no posted points; repeat for a purchase on fraud hold returned at T + 30 h.

Text: WHEN a member returns a purchase after its points were posted, the loyalty service shall reverse the posted points of that purchase.
Criterion: When a member returns a purchase after its points were posted, the posted points of that purchase are reversed and the points balance falls by that amount.
Test idea: Post a purchase of 120 points, return it, and check a Reversed transaction and a balance 120 points lower.

Text: IF a reversal would take a member's points balance below zero, THEN the loyalty service shall TBD.
Criterion: Proposed: when a reversal of P points meets a points balance of B < P, the resulting balance is TBD and TBD happens to the difference P - B.
Test idea: Once the rule is known: member with 100 posted points returns a purchase that earned 300 posted points; check the resulting balance and any follow-up record.
Question: What happens when a reversal would take the balance below zero? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan, with SH-03 Grace Lim)

Text: IF the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall keep the points of that purchase pending until the fraud engine releases the hold.
Criterion: When the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, its points stay pending until the fraud engine releases the hold, and are posted only after the release.
Test idea: Stub the fraud engine to hold a purchase; advance the clock past 24 h and check Pending; send a release and check Posted.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service receives a purchase event or a redemption request, the loyalty service shall send the event to the fraud engine for scoring.
Criterion: For each purchase event and each redemption request the service receives, the fraud engine receives one scoring request for that event.
Test idea: Contract test with a fraud engine stub: send one purchase event and one redemption request; expect two scoring requests with the matching event references.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall include those points in the points balance it returns to the customer mobile app.
Criterion: After the service posts points for a purchase, the next balance response to the customer mobile app includes those points.
Test idea: Post a purchase of 75 points for a member with 200 posted points; call the balance endpoint; expect 275.

Text: WHEN TBD, the loyalty service shall send the member a push notification with the points earned.
Criterion: When TBD happens, the member receives one push notification that states the points earned.
Test idea: With a notification provider stub, trigger the TBD event for a member and check one push request with the points earned.
Question: Is the push sent when the points are pending or when they are posted, and only to members who agreed? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan; consent SH-04 Farid Osman)

Text: WHEN TBD, the loyalty service shall send the member an email with the points earned.
Criterion: When TBD happens, the member receives one email that states the points earned.
Test idea: With an email provider stub (not yet in the context), trigger the TBD event and check one email request.
Question: Is email needed at all, and through which provider? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption request.
Criterion: A redemption request for 499 points is rejected; one for 500 points is not rejected by this rule.
Test idea: Unit test of the redemption rule at 499 and 500 points for a member with 800 posted points.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service accepts a redemption, the loyalty service shall issue the member a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.
Criterion: An accepted redemption of 500 points issues a voucher worth SGD 5, and one of 1,200 points a voucher worth SGD 12.
Test idea: Unit test of the voucher value for 500 and 1,200 points; points that are not a multiple of 100 wait for stories Q2.

Text: IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher that is already applied, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request.
Criterion: When the TillPoint POS asks to validate a voucher in state Applied, the service rejects the request and the voucher stays Applied.
Test idea: Apply a voucher once, send the same validation request again, and check the rejection.

Text: WHILE the fraud engine holds a redemption, the loyalty service shall withhold the voucher of that redemption.
Criterion: While the fraud engine holds a redemption, no voucher of that redemption exists for the member; after the release the voucher is issued.
Test idea: Stub the fraud engine to hold a redemption; check the member's vouchers; release; check again.

Text: IF a support agent submits an adjustment without a reason code, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the adjustment.
Criterion: An adjustment without a reason code is rejected and the points balance is unchanged.
Test idea: Submit an adjustment of 100 points with an empty reason code through the admin console API; expect a rejection and no transaction.

Text: IF a support agent submits an adjustment of more than 5000 points, THEN the loyalty service shall apply the adjustment only after a second approver approves it.
Criterion: An adjustment of 5,000 points is applied without a second approver; one of 5,001 points is applied only after a second approver approves it.
Test idea: Submit adjustments of 5,000 and 5,001 points; check that only the second waits for approval and is applied after it.

Text: WHEN 12 months have passed since points were posted, the loyalty service shall expire those points.
Criterion: Points posted at time T are still posted one day before T + 12 months and expired at T + 12 months.
Test idea: Back-date a posted transaction and run expiry with a controllable clock at both points in time.

Text: WHEN posted points of a member are TBD days from expiry, the loyalty service shall send the member a points-expiring message through the notification provider.
Criterion: When posted points are TBD days from expiry, the member receives one points-expiring message through the notification provider.
Test idea: With a controllable clock and a provider stub, move a posted transaction to TBD days before expiry and check one message.
Question: How many days before expiry, through which channel? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: WHEN a support agent looks up a member in the admin console, the admin console shall display the member's points balance and points history.
Criterion: When a support agent looks up a member in the admin console, the console shows that member's points balance and points history.
Test idea: E2E test in the admin console with a test member that has three points transactions; check the balance and all three history entries.

Text: The loyalty service shall send each member's tier and points summary to Relay CRM once per night.
Criterion: Each night the Relay CRM interface receives one tier and points summary per member.
Test idea: Run the nightly job against a CRM stub with three test members; expect three summaries.
Question: What is a tier, and which interface and fields does the CRM summary use? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan; interface SH-08 Wei Jie Chua)

Text: The loyalty service shall deliver a daily points-liability extract to the data warehouse.
Criterion: Each day the data warehouse receives one points-liability extract with the fields TBD.
Test idea: Run the daily extract job against a warehouse stub; check one extract with the agreed fields.
Question: Which fields must the extract hold, and by when each day? (owner: SH-03 Grace Lim)

Text: As a member, I want to spend 500 of my posted points as an SGD 5 voucher at the till, so that my points reduce what I pay.
Criterion: Acceptance criteria R-024.AC1 to R-024.AC6 pass; R-024.AC7 has an expected result once stories Q1 is answered.
Test idea: E2E test on a test till: redeem 500 of 800 posted points in the app, scan the voucher, check SGD 5 and state Applied; then the unwanted cases AC3 to AC6.
Question: What happens at the till when the service does not answer in time? (owner: SH-02 Arjun Pillai, with SH-09)

Text: As a member, I want to choose how many of my posted points, from 500 upward, to turn into a voucher, so that my points reduce more of what I pay.
Criterion: Acceptance criteria R-025.AC1 and R-025.AC3 pass; R-025.AC2 has an expected result once stories Q2 is answered.
Test idea: E2E test: redeem 1,200 of 1,250 posted points and expect SGD 12 and 50 left; then 2,000 points and expect no voucher.
Question: Are points below the next 100 kept or is the request rejected? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: As a member, I want a push notification when a voucher is issued to me, so that TBD.
Criterion: Acceptance criteria R-026.AC1 and R-026.AC2 have expected results once stories Q3 and Q4 are answered.
Test idea: With a notification provider stub, issue a voucher to a member who agreed to push notifications and check one push naming the voucher value.
Question: Is agreement to push notifications needed, and is a rejected push retried? (owner: SH-04 Farid Osman; SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: WHEN the TillPoint POS sends a voucher validation request, the loyalty service shall return the validation result within TBD milliseconds at the TBD percentile.
Criterion: The server-side response time of voucher validation is at most TBD ms at the TBD percentile under TBD validation requests per minute, measured by load test.
Test idea: Load test of the validation call at the agreed peak rate; record the percentile; repeat in production monitoring after go-live.
Question: What limit, at which percentile and load? Today checkout has no voucher validation (BRIEF.md:74). (owner: SH-02 Arjun Pillai)

Text: WHEN the TillPoint POS sends a purchase event, the loyalty service shall return the points of that purchase to the customer mobile app within TBD seconds at the TBD percentile.
Criterion: The time from the POS purchase event to the points of that purchase in the next balance response is at most TBD seconds at the TBD percentile under TBD load.
Test idea: Send purchase events at the agreed rate and poll the balance endpoint; record the event-to-visible time.
Question: How many seconds, at which percentile, and are the points shown as pending or in the balance? (owner: SH-01 Mei Tan)

Text: WHILE the year-end sale is running, the loyalty service shall accept at least TBD purchase events per minute.
Criterion: The service accepts at least TBD purchase events per minute for TBD minutes without losing an event.
Test idea: Load test at the target rate for the agreed duration; count accepted events against events sent.
Question: Last year's peak was about 9,000 purchases per minute (BRIEF.md:76): is the target that figure or more, and for how long? (owner: SH-08 Wei Jie Chua)

Text: WHILE the year-end sale is running, the loyalty service shall be available for purchase events and voucher validation requests for at least TBD percent of the minutes.
Criterion: During the year-end sale, the share of minutes in which synthetic purchase events and voucher validations succeed is at least TBD percent.
Test idea: Run synthetic probes every minute during the sale and compute availability from the monitoring data afterwards.
Question: Which availability target, and when does the sale run? (owner: SH-08 Wei Jie Chua)

Text: The loyalty service shall reject a voucher validation request that does not carry valid TillPoint POS credentials.
Criterion: A voucher validation request without valid TillPoint POS credentials is rejected, and one with valid credentials is processed.
Test idea: Negative contract test with missing, expired and forged credentials; a penetration test before go-live.

Text: The admin console shall show member personal data only to authenticated support agents.
Criterion: A request for member personal data in the admin console without an authenticated support agent session receives an access-denied response.
Test idea: Call the admin console's member lookup without a session and with a session of a non-agent role; expect access denied.

Text: The loyalty service shall keep audit trail entries for adjustments unchangeable after they are written.
Criterion: An attempt to change or delete an adjustment audit trail entry after it was written fails and the entry is unchanged.
Test idea: Write an adjustment, then try to update and delete its audit entry through every interface the service offers; check the entry.

Text: WHEN a support agent makes an adjustment, the loyalty service shall record the support agent, the time, the reason code and, where R-018 requires one, the approver in the adjustment audit trail.
Criterion: After an adjustment, the audit trail holds the support agent, the time and the reason code, and the approver for adjustments above 5,000 points.
Test idea: Make adjustments of 100 and 6,000 points (the second approved by a second approver); check both audit entries.

Text: The loyalty service shall exchange purchase events and voucher validation messages with the TillPoint POS as defined in the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1.
Criterion: Purchase events and voucher validation messages exchanged with the TillPoint POS validate against the message definitions of the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1.
Test idea: Contract tests generated from the S-02 message definitions, run against the service in CI; a vendor test-till demonstration before go-live.

Text: The loyalty service shall keep points transaction data for 7 years.
Criterion: A points transaction created 7 years minus one day ago is still kept and can be retrieved.
Test idea: Back-date transactions and run the retention job; check what is kept.

Text: The loyalty service shall keep member personal data no longer than TBD.
Criterion: The data inventory and the retention configuration keep member personal data no longer than TBD, checked in review by the data protection officer.
Test idea: Review the data inventory, deletion jobs and backups with SH-04 once the period is set.
Question: How long may member personal data be kept, and from which event? (owner: SH-04 Farid Osman)

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of more points than the member's posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption request.
Criterion: For a member with 800 posted points and 400 pending points, a redemption request for 900 points is rejected and one for 800 points is not rejected by this rule.
Test idea: Unit test of the redemption rule at the posted-balance boundary.

Text: IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher code that does not exist, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the request as not found.
Criterion: When the TillPoint POS asks to validate a voucher code that does not exist, the service rejects the request as not found.
Test idea: Send a validation request with a random code; expect a not-found rejection.
